topic: EXP-617 content-preservation verification: 4 patches addressing c6 holes 1 (major, locked-formula gap) + 2 (moderate, version-instability/tan-identity bridge)

holes_found.description: DISPLAY-TEXT INCONSISTENCY on the two #p4-424 cross-reference links both introduced by EXP-617: P1 uses display text 'Section 4.2.4' (the tan-reduction sub-section) while P2 uses 'Section 4.2' (the broader formula-audit section) for the same anchor. Both resolve to #p4-424 and both are functionally correct — P1 is specifically about the tan identity (sub-section 4.2.4), P2 is about FORM-V51-005 (Section 4.2 formula catalog). However, a careful reader seeing both links in the same field with different display text may wonder if they point to different locations. The verdict (detail_verdict_text) uses plain-text 'Section 4.2.4' (no link) and is consistent with P1. Context: P2's choice of 'Section 4.2' over '4.2.4' is defensible since it is pointing at the formula catalog entry, not the tan-reduction derivation.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional cosmetic fix: harmonize P2's display text to 'Section 4.2.4' or add a parenthetical '(formula catalog)' to distinguish the two uses. Low priority — functionally correct and both anchors resolve; fold into any next WIN-044 touch.
